description: Search an app's accessibility tree for elements by role (e.g. button, textfield, checkbox, row), title, value, text (title or value) or id (AXIdentifier); substring match, case-insensitive, unless exact:true. Returns up to limit (default 10, max 50) matches, each with an element_index (a new snapshot). surface: window (default) | menubar | app; window: index or title, or window_id from mac_windows; web_accessibility (default true, false under NORACU_READ_ONLY=1) sets AXManualAccessibility on Electron/Chromium apps and never sets AXEnhancedUserInterface (which alters window behaviour); the result reports web_accessibility like mac_ax_state.
name: mac_find
